prompt_en: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent character sprite for a dialogue scene in an RPG. Input image is the edit target. Preserve the exact character identity, face, hairstyle, facial expression, anatomy, pose, clothes, colors, fabric texture and all held objects from this reference. Keep the original semi-realistic painting style and original full head-to-hip framing. Isolate this same character and their held objects with crisp natural edges against a genuinely transparent alpha background. Retain fine hair strands and the whole visible silhouette with comfortable transparent margins. Output a single portrait-format transparent PNG.
prompt_ja: 編集対象の人物の顔、髪型、表情、体形、姿勢、衣装、色、質感、手に持つ物、頭から腰までの構図を元画像に忠実に保ち、人物と持ち物を透明背景の立ち絵にしてください。
encoding: 生成PNGをalpha付きWebP quality 94へ変換。形状・構図の加工は行わない。
